Construct a neurothresh result

Source: R/result.R
new_neurothresh_result.Rd

Internal constructor used by every public inference method to return a uniform result object. The S3 class is "neurothresh_result"; downstream code should treat the object as opaque except for the documented slots.

Usage

new_neurothresh_result(
  method,
  stat_vol,
  mask,
  threshold,
  reject,
  pvals,
  clusters = NULL,
  null_max = NULL,
  params = list(),
  call = NULL,
  extras = list()
)

Arguments

method

Character; one of "hier_scan", "octree_scan_fwer", "octree_scan_stepdown", "tfce_fwer", "cluster_fdr", "rft_peak_fwer", "rft_cluster_fwer", or "lisa".

stat_vol

The observed (canonicalized) statistic map.

mask

Logical mask used.

threshold

Critical value on the relevant statistic (numeric scalar).

reject

Logical 3D rejection volume.

pvals

Numeric 3D corrected p-value volume.

clusters

Optional data frame of clusters (NULL for voxelwise-only methods).

null_max

Optional vector of max-null statistics for permutation methods.

params

List of method-specific parameters (alpha/q, tail, n_perm, kappa, H/E, smoothness, etc.).

call

The captured match.call() from the public method.

extras

Optional named list of method-specific extras (e.g., per-node tables for hier_scan, TFCE map for tfce_fwer). Stored under $extras.

Value

Object of class "neurothresh_result".
